content.short: SHEN reinforces the reserve rate of Djed's smart contract, providing added stability to the stablecoin.
content.description: When purchasing Djed, the smart contract automatically converts the deposited ADA into the stablecoin, turning it into a liability. However, the value of ADA can fluctuate, potentially resulting in a loss if the token is sold back to the smart contract. This is where SHEN steps in, providing additional equity and reserves compared to the initial deposit of ADA. The token serves as an indicator of the stability of the reserve index, with a higher reserve index providing greater protection for Djed.
content.meta: Find out about Shen (SHEN) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
